notes: Placeholder skins are procedurally generated and are NOT the real creators' skins. The four playable heroes and all fourteen tower characters now use skins supplied by the project owner.

To use a real skin: place a Minecraft-compatible 64x64 (or 64x32 / HD) PNG at assets/skins/<id>.png (or user://skins/<id>.png at runtime) and update this manifest's source/license fields. Supplied files are never overwritten by tools/gen_assets.py.

A Minecraft resource pack IS included at assets/resourcepack/ (vanilla-layout textures: blocks, items, entities, humanoid armour layers, enchantment glint). ResourcePack (scripts/core/resource_pack.gd) sources textures from it and falls back to the project's generated stand-ins for anything missing; user://resourcepack/ overrides it at runtime. IMPORTANT: this artwork is Mojang's, not this project's. It is committed at the explicit direction of the project owner. Mojang's permission has NOT been obtained and is not claimed; anyone redistributing this repository or a build made from it is responsible for clearing that. Removing it is a one-line change — delete the directory and every texture falls back to the generated placeholders.
This is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Unstable Universe creators or Mojang/Microsoft.

Voice lines are looked up by convention at assets/audio/voice/<character>_<key>.<ext>. A character with no recording is silent, so adding another creator's lines needs no code and no data entry — just the files. Keys are listed in docs/VOICE_LINES.md.
